summary: Iter132 (visual production pass checkpoint #2 — platformer + top_down promotion) largely PASS. Backend regression: 12/12 pytest green (test_iter130_honesty_and_trim 4/4 + test_shooter_owr_launch 5/5 + test_iter131_production_repair 3/3, /app/test_reports/pytest/iter132.xml). GET /api/games/{id} confirms all four hero demos retain their real spec.assets: Crystal Caverns (platformer) and Cyber Heist (top_down) each have {player_sprite, background, enemy_sprite} (3 slots), Neon Breach shooter has same 3-slot set, Emberwild OWR has 4 slots incl. npc_sprite. Proof games (proof-platformer-goal-v1, proof-topdown-portal-v1) present and founder-only, each with 1 stage. Catalog /api/gamemaker/catalog live=action_rpg_2_5d/shooter/open_world_rpg, platformer+top_down_adventure still beta (correct pre-promotion state). Frontend (founder stealth): CRYSTAL CAVERNS — painterly cavern background art rendered (not plain grid), hearts+HUD visible, ArrowRight+ArrowUp movement + jump both work, gem pickups drove Score 0→10→20→30, and '✓ Cavern 1 — The Entry Grotto complete!' fired at t~4.5s: complete platformer proof (movement+collision+pickup+stage-complete). CYBER HEIST — overhead facility BACKGROUND ART rendered (detailed tech corridors/rooms, not procedural navy buildings), player sprite with cyan glow-ring locator visible, red drone enemy sprite visible (not procedural triangle), 4 cyan cores visible, HUD 'Cores left: 4', __DBG_POS returns {x,y,rt:'top_down'}, __DBG_TD exposes {cores:[...], portal, obs}, ArrowRight moved 30→333 x, ArrowDown+ArrowRight moved diagonally, 8-dir keys accepted. PROOF PLATFORMER — Score 10 (core pickup), '✓ Proof Ledge complete!' printed within 4s of holding ArrowRight: full mechanics proof passes (walk+collision+pickup+goal portal). NEON BREACH regression — real hex/tech background art, player sprite with glow, red enemy sprites, HUD Score 10 (auto-fire), __DBG_POS rt='shooter'. EMBERWILD regression — painterly terrain (grass, rocks, crystals, burn scars), player+glow, Quests 0/2 HUD, __DBG_POS rt='open_world_rpg' cx=0,cy=489. MOBILE Cyber Heist 390x844→844x390: canvas width 364→818 (ratio 2.247x >1.5x) with NO reload, HUD 'Stage 1/9 · Score 0' preserved, rotate-prompt-in-frame count=0 in landscape (self-removes) — confirms the iter132 rotatePrompt landscape fix works. Zero non-401 console errors across all runs. TWO PARTIAL VERIFICATIONS (not blockers, see integration_issues): (a) Cyber Heist core pickup — automation could not touch a core before the security chaser depleted hearts (♥♥♥→GAME OVER at ~15s); this is by-design combat difficulty and pickup mechanic is exercised in the proof stage. (b) proof-topdown-portal-v1 — __DBG_TD.cores expose correctly and player moves initially from x=30→x=413 via keydown/keyup, but after that first burst the __DBG_POS oscillates around (~410, ~210) and does not converge on the core at (334,176) despite continued directional dispatchEvent(keydown/keyup) toward Left+Up. Cores stayed at 2 and portal stayed null for the full 30s test window. Hearts remained ♥♥♥ so player wasn't dying — this may be a testing-agent input-injection quirk (game may require sustained keydown across ticks rather than burst dispatch) rather than a game bug, since the exact same script pattern completes proof-platformer in 4s. Recommend main agent try a manual founder pass to confirm proof-td portal mechanic completes end-to-end before promoting top_down_adventure.

integration_issues.issue: Automated arrow-key dispatch to iframe document moves player initially (x=30→x=413) but subsequent Left/Up dispatches don't produce further motion. __DBG_TD.cores never decrements from 2, portal stays null. Same script pattern completes Crystal Caverns platformer + proof-platformer-goal-v1 without issue, so this is likely input-injection specific to td runtime — recommend manual founder verification. Cores/portal are correctly exposed on window.__DBG_TD.

integration_issues.flow: Cyber Heist core pickup verification (published demo)
integration_issues.issue: Security chaser depleted 3 hearts in ~15s before automation could steer to nearest core (drone at ~(405,440), cores at ~(608,460)/(600,627)). Not a bug — background art / player sprite / enemy sprite all render correctly and 8-dir movement is confirmed via __DBG_POS. Just note that a bare automated 'walk to core' run dies in the published demo; use proof-td for the completion signal.

action_items: Founder manual pass on /games?play=proof-topdown-portal-v1 (hold arrow keys via real keyboard, not dispatchEvent) to confirm 2-core pickup + portal unlock + portal entry victory before promoting top_down_adventure to live. Automation could not fully drive it end-to-end but backend spec + __DBG_TD exposure + initial movement all check out.
OPTIONAL: consider bumping proof-topdown-portal-v1 down to 0 patrols (spec says 1 slow patrol currently) so future automation can complete without chaser risk, or expose a debug key-hold helper.
critical_code_review_comments: GameRuntime.jsx rotatePrompt (line 166–178) landscape self-removal works as advertised — verified live: mobile Cyber Heist 390x844 shows nothing (portrait shows prompt only if MOB && preferred landscape), and after rotating to 844x390 the prompt count inside content_frame is 0. Good fix.

td() runtime correctly exposes window.__DBG_TD each frame with {cores:[{x,y}], portal:{x,y}|null, obs} — enables the exact automation contract the checkpoint asked for. rt marker 'top_down' present on __DBG_POS.

pf() runtime completion feedback ('✓ <stage> complete!' green text) renders reliably; proof-platformer stage cleared in ~4s with a hold of ArrowRight starting from x=~30 — confirms core pickup + goal-portal collision (goal at x=90%). No __DBG_POS on pf() is fine because HUD signals suffice.

Real generated art integration is genuinely complete for both new runtimes: painterly cavern (Crystal Caverns) and overhead tech facility (Cyber Heist) both render immediately with no fallback grid/procedural geometry. Player sprites carry the glow (paintHeroSide/paintHeroTop) and enemy sprite art replaces triangles.

MINOR OBSERVATION: Cyber Heist chaser in the published demo is very aggressive against a stationary player (3 hearts in ~15s). Not a bug for this checkpoint but worth noting for a future difficulty tuning pass.

Proof TD ~70% (spec+exposure+initial-movement OK; portal-entry victory not automated). Shooter+OWR regression 100%. Mobile orientation 100%.

rca of the issue: N/A — no game bugs blocking checkpoint. Only automation limitation on proof-td portal completion: dispatchEvent(keydown) then dispatchEvent(keyup) 500ms later inside the sandboxed iframe appears to register on the first burst (player moved 379px) but subsequent bursts don't accumulate motion in the td runtime, though the same pattern works for pf() and shooter/owr movement testing. Not reproducible manually according to spec (0 obstacles, 2 cores, 1 slow patrol) — this is the exact scenario designed to prove td portal mechanics. Recommend main agent one manual founder playthrough of /games?play=proof-topdown-portal-v1 before promoting top_down_adventure to live in the catalog.
